name: Select

props.note: Swap in a Select / Menu built from Select / Option instances. Code takes an array, with optional groups; Figma shows a group label with Menu showGroupLabel.
Same name. Figma default is sample text; web has no default and native defaults to Select….
Figma value is sample text for the filled state. There is no controlled / uncontrolled split.
Same name, different trigger. Figma shows the text when state=invalid; in code, setting error makes the select invalid.
disabled is state=disabled in Figma. required has no Figma property.
Shows a group heading. In code that is an options group with its own label.
disabled is options[].disabled; selected is the current value.
Figma-only axis for specs and prototypes. open shows the list, which is internal state in code. invalid comes from error, disabled from disabled.

purpose: Form control for choosing one value from a list. Web uses the native <select> (platform pickers on mobile browsers); native opens an accessible bottom-sheet list.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean } | { label: string; options: SelectOption[] }>
props.description: Options; groups render as <optgroup> on web.

states.name: default
states.description: Closed with current value or placeholder.

states.name: open
states.description: List is showing. Web (Chromium 135+): styled list anchored to the control, same border width, options padded space.xs/space.sm with hover and checked styles. Other browsers and native: platform picker / sheet.

tokens.usage: Open list background (styled list and native option sheet).
Inline padding of the control and of each option, so option text lines up with the closed value.
Control and open list border (border.width.thick when invalid).

accessibility.role: combobox/listbox (native <select>) / button that opens a radio list on native
screenReader: Announces label, current value, 'popup button' / 'combo box', and position in list.
notes: Never navigate or submit on change (3.2.2).

variants.name: grouped
variants.description: Options organized under group labels (e.g. teams by division).

do: Use for 6+ options or when space is tight.
Order options logically; put the most common first if there's no natural order.
Use a placeholder when there is no sensible default.
dont: Don't use for actions; use Dropdown.
Don't use for 2 to 5 options when space allows; use RadioGroup.

related.name: Search
related.reason: Very long lists may need type-ahead search.

example.web:
<Select
  label="Division"
  placeholder="Choose a division"
  options={[
    { value: 'u12', label: 'Under 12' },
    { value: 'u14', label: 'Under 14' },
    { value: 'open', label: 'Open' },
  ]}
  required
/>
example.native: <Select label="Division" placeholder="Choose a division" value={division} onValueChange={setDivision} options={divisions} />
